hero.tagline: Sourcing local just got smarter. The ultimate AI-powered ecosystem for Canadian Manufacturing Enterprises.

node1.title: 1. Instant Onboarding
node1.body: Buyers and storefront accounts set up in seconds. Suppliers can auto-generate a full profile using our 2-minute AI website importer.

node2.title: 2. Request or List
node2.body: Buyers and suppliers can post targeted RFQs to the network. Suppliers and storefront accounts can also list surplus materials, equipment, or available capacity.

node3.title: 3. Match & Collaborate
node3.body: Access direct contact details to make connections. Negotiate your own terms and build long-lasting business-to-business relationships.

help.title: Help Centre
help.subtitle: Browse our FAQs and helpful resources to find answers to your questions.
help.metaDescription: Find answers to your questions about Marcan.
help.a1p1: Yes. Marcan is free to join and use for Canadian manufacturing and industrial businesses. You can create accounts, browse the
help.a1p3: , and post sourcing requests without subscriptions, commissions, or paywalls on the platform itself.
help.q2: Who can use Marcan (e.g. Canadian manufacturing focus)?
help.a2: Marcan is built for Canadian manufacturing and industry — job shops, contract manufacturers, distributors, OEMs, and related suppliers. You can sign up as a buyer or supplier to search the ecosystem; buyer and supplier accounts can post sourcing requests (RFQs). Company profiles in the directory, supplier onboarding, and storefront selling are meant for organizations that operate and serve customers in Canada.
help.q3: What is the difference between a buyer account, a supplier account, and a storefront seller?
help.a3p2: is for procurement teams who want to search the ecosystem, use the directory, and publish sourcing requests (RFQs). A
help.a3p3: is the full network path: company profile in the directory, RFQ visibility, optional AI-assisted setup from your website, storefront-style listings, and the same ability to post outbound sourcing requests (RFQs) as a buyer account. A
help.a3p4: is focused on listing surplus materials, parts, or equipment in the Shop with a lighter storefront onboarding. Paths are started from
help.a3p5: ; buyer and supplier or storefront flows use separate onboarding steps.
help.q4: What is the AI search on the home page for?
help.a4: The large prompt on the home page lets you describe what you need in plain language (for example capabilities, certifications, or industries). Submitting it takes you to Marcan's search experience so you can discover relevant companies and content from that query instead of typing exact keywords alone.
help.q5: What is the Company Directory and how do I use it?
help.a5p2: is a browsable list of supplier company profiles — capabilities, certifications, industries, locations, and public contact details when provided. Open it from the sidebar, filter or explore listings, and click through to a company's profile to learn more and reach out directly.
help.q6: How do I become a supplier and get a company profile in the directory?
help.a6p2: and choose the supplier path. Complete the onboarding form (website import or manual). Once your profile is submitted and active, your company can appear in the Company Directory and be discoverable alongside your listings and RFQ-related activity as applicable.
help.q7: How does the website URL / AI import work for building my supplier profile?
help.a7p2: URL for your company website. Marcan uses automated extraction to pull structured hints about your business — such as capabilities, location, and services — into the supplier onboarding flow. You always review and edit those fields before your profile is finalized; nothing is published without your completion of the wizard.
help.q8: What if I don't have a website or prefer to enter my details manually?
help.a8p1: During supplier onboarding, choose the manual path instead of import (the link offered next to the website field). You'll step through the same company, capability, and contact sections yourself. You can also find it here
help.q9: What are sourcing requests (RFQs) and how do I post one?
help.a9p1: Sourcing requests are structured RFQs describing parts, materials, services, quantities, or timelines you need. Signed-in buyers and suppliers can create them from the
help.a9p2: flow (when signed in). Other users can discover your request and contact you using the details you choose to display. You can track what you've published from
help.q10: How do I contact a company I find on Marcan?
help.a10: Open the company's directory or storefront profile and use the RFQ email, phone, or website they list. Shop listings and sourcing requests show the contact fields each party opted into. Marcan does not host in-app messaging for negotiations — you reach out directly by email or phone.
help.q11: Does Marcan handle payments, shipping, or contracts between users?
help.a11: No. Marcan is a discovery and connection layer: profiles, listings, and RFQs help you find each other. Pricing, invoicing, shipping, quality terms, and contracts are agreed directly between buyers and suppliers. Always perform your own diligence before placing orders or sharing sensitive information.
help.q12: Who do I contact if something breaks?
help.a12p2: page to send a message describing what went wrong. We use that channel for technical issues, account questions, and feedback about the platform.

about.heroSubtitle: Learn about us and our mission to connect Canada’s manufacturing capabilities and simplify local sourcing.
about.whoWeAreBodyPrefix: We're a team of engineering students working at the
about.whoWeAreBodySuffix: . Our goal is simple: minimize fragmentation for Canadian manufacturers.
about.whyBody: For too long, local sourcing has been hindered by outdated directories and disconnected networks. We are removing the friction from domestic procurement so Canadian businesses can find and trade with one another more easily.
about.visionBody: A future where Canadian manufacturing is easy to discover, easy to source, and easy to trust. We are building Marcan to help the right shop win the right work again and again.
about.whatWeDoSubtitle: A focused workflow for real-world manufacturing: find capacity, communicate clearly, and move decisions forward.
about.card1Body: Browse suppliers and manufacturing capabilities using our AI search tool built exclusively for Canadian businesses.
about.card2Body: Publish equipment, materials, surplus parts, and capacity so buyers can find you faster.
about.card3Body: Buyers and suppliers can publish targeted sourcing requests and connect directly, so conversations start on the right spec.
about.ctaBody: Join Marcan to connect directly with local manufacturers and to build a more resilient Canadian manufacturing industry.
about.metaDescription: Learn about Marcan, a premium B2B network built to revitalize Canadian manufacturing through fast, local connections.
